78454.subject: A Memecoin Ran A Nasdaq Stock Up 321%
78454.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[Money Mushroom](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/money-mushroom-moved-a-nasdaq-penny-stock-but-its-tokenized-stock-is-a-memecoin-too)**[ ran a Nasdaq stock up 321% against a token Robinhood never issued.](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/money-mushroom-moved-a-nasdaq-penny-stock-but-its-tokenized-stock-is-a-memecoin-too)

* **[21 banks and asset managers](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/21-financial-institutions-commit-to-joint-stablecoin-venture)**[ will incorporate a dollar stablecoin issuer this year.](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/21-financial-institutions-commit-to-joint-stablecoin-venture)

* **[Nomura's Laser Digital](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/nomura-laser-digital-keyring-defi-fixed-income-euler)**[ will set the risk parameters for lending markets on Euler.](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/nomura-laser-digital-keyring-defi-fixed-income-euler)

* **[The SEC](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/sec-proposes-transfer-agent-rules-for-blockchain-based-share-records)**[ proposed transfer agent rules that name blockchain registries.](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/sec-proposes-transfer-agent-rules-for-blockchain-based-share-records)

* **[Bitcoin](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-holds-77000-after-weak-adp-hiring-print)**[ held $77,000 as weak hiring left a September rate increase favored.](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-holds-77000-after-weak-adp-hiring-print)

* **[Why DeFi Needs Onchain Insurance: The $100 Billion Coverage Gap](https://thedefiant.io/education/research-and-opinion/defi-needs-onchain-insurance-100-billion-coverage-gap)**[ (Partner)](https://thedefiant.io/education/research-and-opinion/defi-needs-onchain-insurance-100-billion-coverage-gap)

Farmmi sells dried mushrooms and trades bulk cotton and corn out of Lishui, in Zhejiang province, and has until February 2027 to close above a dollar for ten straight sessions or lose its Nasdaq listing. On Wednesday its shares traded as high as $0.50 from Tuesday's $0.1187 close, up as much as 321%, on 806 million shares against a 5.2 million daily average. The buying started with a memecoin named after a mushroom variety in the company's own annual report.

Money Mushroom trades against a FAMI token on Robinhood Chain that one wallet [minted in a single transaction](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/money-mushroom-moved-a-nasdaq-penny-stock-but-its-tokenized-stock-is-a-memecoin-too), kept 38% of, and has spent two days repricing through a contract it deployed itself. Robinhood has never issued a Farmmi stock token. Its real tokenized stocks are issued by a Jersey entity with an authorized participant who can mint and redeem, which helps keep their prices near the share price.

Traders on that chain have spent two months trying to make a memecoin move an equity. BONER held [53% of the tokenized Hims & Hers float](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/a-mem

“Anticipation is the greatest part of pleasure.”
_— Angela Carter_



----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/25feca5e-8abf-477c-b654-ae6275b8987f/unnamed.png?t=1788384953)
Caption: 

# The transaction is the product

Hermès Birkin bags are the quintessential Veblen good: The more they cost, the more people want them.

The most affordable model — the Birkin 25 — now costs $13,500. The Diamond Himalaya (pictured above) will set you back $250,000.

If, that is, you can persuade Hermès to sell you one.

Few do.

Last year, Hermès faced a [class action lawsuit](https://appliedantitrust.com/22_tying/case_studies/cavaller_hermes2024/01_ndcalif/cavalleri_ndcalif_complaint_amended2024_05_30.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com) alleging that the company unlawfully ties the purchase of its Birkin handbags to the purchase of other Hermès products: If you don’t buy enough shoes, scarves, clothing, and jewelry from Hermès, it won’t let you give it tens of thousands of dollars in exchange for a handbag.

It’s difficult for me to imagine caring enough about something as non-essential as a handbag that I would take the seller to court for not letting me buy from them. Is that a good use of the US legal system?

Judge James Donato seemed to think not. He dismissed the case last September, ruling that consumer frustration over not getting a bag is a personal grievance, not a violation of federal law.

The frustration, however, is real.

Unlike other Hermès products, which you can purchase on its website, Birkin bags are only sold in stores. You will not, however, see one there — unless you’ve been deemed worthy of being escorted into a back room for a private viewing.

To even be considered for such a privilege, you’ll need a salesperson to advocate for you. Hermès does not pay its sales associates their usual 3% commission on Birkin bags, so you’ll have to earn their trust by buying a bunch of other things first.

The effective acquisition cost of a Birkin bag is therefore much higher than the sticker price, as outrageous as that already is. It also includes  the time spent cultivating a relationship with a sales associate, the cost of all the other Hermès products you had to buy, and the effort of making repeated trips to a store that is probably not nearby.

Still, it can be a good investment.

Birkin bags on the secondary

78407.subject: AVALANCHE AUGUST 2026 RECAP
78407.body:
View this post on the web at https://www.team1.blog/p/avalanche-august-2026-recap

August was the month Wall Street started showing up on Avalanche in earnest. Charles Schwab added AVAX for its 40 million brokerage accounts, Dinari brought 724 tokenized U.S. stocks including the full S&P 500 to Avalanche investors, and POSCO International completed a proof of concept for tokenizing global trade receivables on the network.
At the same time, Team1 officially launched in Korea. With Avalanche Summit NYC less than three weeks away, September is shaping up to be a major moment for the ecosystem.
Here’s everything that happened in August.
Want to keep up with the latest in the Avalanche ecosystem? Subscribe to the Team1 blog and get our updates in your inbox weekly.
Tokenized Assets Grow Nearly 8x in a Year:
Tokenized assets on Avalanche climbed from $242 million to $1.93 billion over the past year, with Securitize now accounting for more than half of that value. [Growth [ https://substack.com/redirect/5fc6043c-d884-4242-90b9-611b3d9b8308?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Foundation Introduces Gross Chain Income:
The Avalanche Foundation published a new Gross Chain Income framework from Lead Economist Eric Lu, extending its Gross Chain Product work into a three-step model for measuring, capturing, and distributing value across the ecosystem. [GCI [ https://substack.com/redirect/92d16235-ee07-40f6-a010-1a719e9a302b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
RWA Transfer Volume Jumps 360% in 30 Days:
Avalanche’s RWA ecosystem recorded $365.29 million in 30-day transfer volume, up 360.15% from the prior month, spanning tokenized funds, equities, treasuries, and private credit. [Volume [ https://substack.com/redirect/183ebb6c-4c8e-4af8-ad57-0c24db4d6fce?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Team1 Korea Officially Launches:
Team1 Korea launched after onboarding more than 500 builders, 12 teams, 200-plus developers, and 80-plus founders, giving Korean talent a clearer path to build on Avalanche.
Team1 Chapters Stay Busy Across Five Continents:
Team1 chapters continued bringing Avalanche directly to local builders. August highlights included a builder workshop in Seoul focused on AI-agent payments, a meetup in Reggio Calabria, a Builder Connect at Oracle’s Bogotá offices, an L1 workshop in Türkiye, university activity in Vietnam, and multiple builder and community events across Brazil, India, Latin America, Nigeria and lots more.
New paths for funding and support opened up this month.
Team1 Opens Applications for ProtocolCamp Cohort 10:
Team1 called for builders to join ProtocolCamp Cohort 10, a 12-week program turning ideas into shipped products with travel covered and a kickoff during Korea Blockchain Week. [ProtocolCamp [ https://substack.com/redirect/484aea27-85f1-40c0-922a-43f8706045a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEW
